hebrew:
וְתֵן טַל וּמָטָר לִבְרָכָה

עַל פְּנֵי הָאֲדָמָה,

וְשַׂבְּעֵנוּ מִטּוּבֶךָ

וּבָרֵךְ שְׁנָתֵנוּ כַּשָּׁנִים הַטּוֹבוֹת
translation: And give dew and rain for blessing on the face of the earth and we should be satiated from its goodness and bless our year as the good years.
